Our Story

Built from a problem we had ourselves.

Oakwood started with a simple problem: we wanted to invest our own capital in real estate, but found that the strongest opportunities were often reserved for institutional investors. We built Oakwood to close that gap. Today, we invest meaningful capital of our own in every opportunity and open select investments to private investors alongside us.

What We Do

An investment platform, with a family office's instincts.

Oakwood Realty Advisors sources, underwrites and invests in real estate opportunities alongside proven institutional sponsors and operators. We bring a family office mindset to each investment, focusing on disciplined underwriting, experienced partners and strong alignment of interests. Select opportunities are then made available to our private investor network.

Our Approach

Selective. Aligned. Relationship-driven.

Selective

We pursue a narrow set of opportunities in the lower and middle market, where discipline matters more than scale.

Aligned

Oakwood commits meaningful capital to every investment it brings forward, alongside the investors who join us.

Relationship-Driven

We invest through long-standing partnerships with operating partners we know well, rather than chasing one-off deals.

Who We Serve

Built for a select group of private investors.

High-Net-Worth Individuals

Accredited individuals looking for direct access to real estate opportunities, alongside a sponsor who invests its own capital in every deal.

Family Offices

Family offices seeking real estate exposure managed with the same discipline and alignment they would expect from their own investment process.

RIAs

Registered investment advisors looking to offer clients curated real estate opportunities backed by Oakwood's own capital.
